FIELDS.NAME: CleanCare Diaper & Linen Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanCare Diaper & Linen Services specializes in providing high-quality laundering and delivery services for diapers and linens. Our operations include the collection, washing, sanitizing, and delivery of clean linen and diaper supplies, primarily catering to healthcare, childcare, and residential clients. We employ state-of-the-art automated equipment that minimizes manual handling, thus enhancing efficiency and reducing potential workplace injuries. Rigorous hygiene and contamination control protocols are applied at every stage of our operations to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness are maintained. Our facility follows a comprehensive maintenance schedule for all equipment, supported by regular training for our employees, which underpins our commitment to a safe working environment and regulatory compliance. With a focus on environmental best practices, we responsibly manage waste disposal and chemical usage, ensuring our operations align with industry standards while serving our community effectively.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "CleanCare Delivery Solutions, LLC - providing logistics and delivery services for healthcare and childcare supplies."
